C0572.title: Illicit "Coupon Scalping" Case: Using Cheat Software to Place Low-Price Orders for Profit
C0572.summary: Xi'an police cracked an illegal "coupon scalping" case. Starting October 2024, a suspect surnamed Wang developed cheat software, promoted it through group chats, and guided buyers to use the software to place bulk orders on a platform at extremely low prices such as 0.01 yuan or 1.01 yuan, exploiting merchant discounts and subsidies before reselling the goods for profit.

references.title: Cyber Police Crack Down on an Illegal Coupon Arbitrage Case
